sources.title: PDF ORYZA - International Rice Research Institute
sources.snippet: Results To date, ORYZA has reached 145 countries and almost 12,000 users. According to our analytics, almost 45% of those surveyed indicated that they are using the ORYZA model for their current research/work study; 30% would like to learn how to use the model and 25% would like to explore the possibility of using the model in their future research/work.

sources.title: Roryza: ORYZA Rice Crop Growth Simulation Model
sources.snippet: An R/C++ implementation of the ORYZA rice crop growth model. ORYZA is a dynamic simulation model that uses daily weather data and crop, soil and management parameters to simulate rice growth and development.
